translations.en: I'll be happy if it gives you a bit more fighting power.
There isn't much else I can do.
Use this weapon and give it your best shot.
You are not sure this alone will let you stand against
the monsters trying to break the seal, but it has certainly
strengthened your fighting force.
When you thank her once more for making the weapon,
@7rCarmine@0r turns away as though hiding her embarrassment,
and quickly heads for the counter.
@7rCarmine@0r said she would give you a weapon.
You should make room in your inventory before speaking to her.
Now, hurry up and gather the materials.
I'll get everything ready for the alchemy while you're gone.
Changed your mind about making a weapon?
It makes no difference to me whether you make one or not,
but if you want to, I'll help.
That's more like it.
Listen. I'll read out the ingredients, and you go gather them.
@3rIron Ore@0r, a @3rCrystal Fragment@0r, @3rSteel@0r,
a @3rFire Ore@0r, and a @3rGolden Branch@0r.
Those are the five materials we need.
They're all supposed to be on the upper levels of @6rGraham Labyrinth@0r,
so go and gather them.
You should head to @6rGraham Labyrinth@0r
and gather @3rIron Ore@0r, a @3rCrystal Fragment@0r, @3rSteel@0r, @3rFire Ore@0r,
and a @3rGolden Branch@0r.
Huh? You didn't want a weapon?
Well, that's fine, then.
Tell me anytime if you change your mind.
I'm thinking of making a powerful weapon. Interested?
Don't you think your current weapons are a little inadequate
for fighting the demons guarding the gate to another world?
I found an alchemical device that makes weapons,
supposedly built by a mage long ago.
Apparently, it only has one use left.
I don't know whether it can really produce weapons
as powerful as the instructions claim,
but I think it's worth trying.
If we got something like a @3rDemon Slayer@0r, we'd be doing very well.
All you have to do is gather the materials needed to make the weapon.
Want to give it a try?
You received the @3rStaff of Judgment@0r.
By the time you reach the tavern,
@7rAnselm@0r has lost consciousness.
@7rBeatrix@0r shows no sign of losing heart,
and hands you your reward as soon as you arrive.
This is your reward for accompanying us to undo the seal.
It also includes an advance payment.
An advance? For what?
Now that @7rAnselm@0r has dispelled the magic circle, travel between this city

translations.en: and the outside world should now be unrestricted...
I'll find a way to activate the magic circle that seals the otherworldly gate again.
I'd like you to escort me there for that final activation.
Even if the seal is gone and we can come and go freely,
the world will eventually end if the otherworldly gate stays open.
Then helping us seal it again wouldn't be such a bad idea, would it?
Her eyes glistening with tears, she holds herself bravely upright,
and @7rBeatrix@0r looks straight at you.
Meanwhile, with a challenging expression that seems to say, "Go on, run if you like,"
@7rCarmine@0r watches you as well.
You cannot abandon these two as they struggle to fight
to the very end and simply run away.
From @7rBeatrix@0r, as your reward and advance, you received @3r20,000 G@0r and
I'll find a way to activate the sealing circle. I promise.
So trust me and wait.
As a reward and advance, @7rBeatrix@0r offers you @3r20,000 G@0r,
and you accept it.
What's the matter?
As soon as you're ready, let's head for the lowest level of @6rGraham@0r.
We're relying on your skills.
I was just about to tell you I needed a word.
Here is an item from a thief who entered this labyrinth with @7rChu Lu Gah@0r
and helped create the seal. A descendant of that thief
gave it to me.
An item from one of his party members?
Where did you find something like that?!
I haven't spent all this time sitting around doing nothing.
I've been conducting various investigations behind the scenes.
Apparently, @7rChu Lu Gah@0r left this item as a precaution,
a secret means of sealing the gate anew.

context: Carmine lists alchemical ingredients; Anselm loses consciousness after undoing the seal; the party plans to seal the otherworldly gate again.
